Official Early Access FAQ: starting areas
stat_facts: Increases health and reduces chance to be dazed in combat (wiki Statistics; '1 STA = 1 HP' is marked 'need testing' there).
Increases melee and ranged weapon damage and shield block amounts; 1 STR = 2 weight (wiki Statistics).
Increases hit rate, weapon proc frequency and gives a channeling bonus to spellcasters (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if INT is higher than WIS, and offensive spell damage (wiki Statistics).
Mana pool size if WIS is higher than INT, and healing done; 4 mana per WIS point for WIS-based classes (wiki Statistics).
Merchant prices and charm break rate on paper; the wiki notes CHA did not seem to affect vendor prices in beta (May 2026).
class_mod: +1 STR, +3 DEX, +4 AGI  (wiki Monk Creation Guide)

mana.text: No spell on the wiki Monk list has a numeric mana cost.
mana.label: FACT

builds.name: Puller (default)
builds.why: Monks pull with feign death and can avoidance off-tank (official). AGI mitigation and STA keep you alive on the pull; DEX for hit rate.

builds.name: Damage
builds.why: Fists and kicks scale with weapon damage and hit rate (wiki Statistics).

build_caveat: Point totals are from the wiki race pages (10 bonus points for every listed race/class). Whether a stat has a per-point cap or diminishing returns at creation is not documented on the wiki: UNVERIFIED.

traits.why: Agile: +5% AGI and a 15-second +50% AGI burst for avoidance.
Brawler (Monk only) starts Dual Wield at 20 and raises it 25% faster.
Forage finds food and drink in the field, so fewer vendor runs. Monks may take it. Infravision or Ultravision only if your race may take it (see the race note).
Medic for bandages between pulls; Monks can mend their own wounds (official) but Bind Wound still helps early. Miner for coin.

trait_caveat: Trait text and race/class limits are from Template:Traits; picks that your race cannot take are swapped automatically in the race note. Which trait is 'best' is STRATEGY; no sourced numbers compare them.

pros: Highest starting AGI of the playable Monk races (22).
cons: Lowest starting STR of the playable Monk races (15).
Racial ability not documented on the wiki race page.
Evil alignment; starts as a Monk in Ail'Vorith. Night Harbor is the start for good and neutral combinations (official FAQ); how it treats evil races is not sourced yet.

pros: Highest starting STR of the playable Monk races (17).
Racial: Tenacity: +15% resistance to Mesmerize and Incapacitate, plus an active 15-second immunity.
Neutral alignment; starts as a Monk in Night Harbor.
cons: Lowest starting AGI of the playable Monk races (20).

planned_races.Var'nai: Listed on the official Monk page but not playable in Early Access (no wiki start-city row).

why.mining: Gathering for coin; pairs with the Miner trait (this Codex's default set).
why.smelting: Turns ore into sellable bars (separate skill on the wiki).
why.lumberjacking: Second gathering skill for coin, part of the default set.
why.bind-wound: Bandaging between pulls cuts downtime for classes without strong self-heals.

tradeskills.note: Gathering defaults plus Bind Wound. Smithing stays off. STRATEGY.
